description.value: L.A. Grill is a casual, sports-bar-style restaurant in Richmond, BC with over two decades of experience, offering a wide variety of comfort food including burgers, pastas, seafood, and salads in generous portions. The atmosphere is described as trendy and modern, with TVs for watching sports alongside a wine selection for a more relaxed visit. Touring cyclists would find a large, varied menu at everyday-friendly prices in a sit-down setting.
